description: The tables and views of a Snowflake or Databricks connection whose full name, database.schema.table, holds any word of query, in any case, at most 50, read with the user's access to the connection, as its default user when one is set. The first search of a connection reads its whole catalog, which can take a while on a large warehouse. Search by the name the user gives and confirm the table with the user, then add it to a report with addReportDatasheets by its connection, database, schema and table, and pass the datasheet id on sendReportMessage: the slides agent queries it in the warehouse with SQL over all its rows. listConnections gives the connection's type and id.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: Unique identifier for the connection, from `listConnections`, which also returns its `type`.

type.description: The type of connection, as `type` in `listConnections`: the `Snowflake` or `Databricks` data warehouse.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

Words to search for in names, separated by spaces: a dashboard, table, model or spreadsheet is returned when its name contains any of them, case-insensitively, a table's full name with its database and schema. If omitted, results aren't filtered by name. At most 50 results are returned either way.

name: searchTables
title: Search tables
